# Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta4

This is the matching frontend prerelease for **Navimower 0.5.0-beta4**.

There is no new Map Card rendering behavior in this beta. The frontend remains
functionally identical to 0.4.0-beta3.

The paired backend adds a forward-only vendor trail gap guard:

- only newly appended vendor trail edges are inspected;
- a new edge jumping more than 5 m starts a new route segment;
- existing retained route geometry is not retroactively rescanned or rebuilt.

This small version pair is intentionally released before the next larger
Canonical/Map API migration step so new mowing routes can be observed in the
field first.
